sourcePrompts.background:
Use case: style-transfer / environment refinement. EDIT the attached existing empty warehouse background. Preserve its exact WIDE 3:1 panorama composition, straight-on camera, column positions at left and right, diagonal braces from upper corners, overhead roof beams and trusses, two pendant worklights over the central area, continuous raised platform near the bottom, right-hand railing and fluorescent worklight. This is the background behind the commentators in Evolution Wars, a televised tournament improvised by a tech millionaire in a real hangar on a Pacific island. Rebuild material rendering and physical construction to be MORE BELIEVABLE, understated and practical. Photograph-derived, grounded detailed game pixel art, NOT a glossy dramatic movie set.
Structural steel is painted matte near-black/charcoal, with a few grey rub marks and tiny patches of oxidation at actual joints, NOT bright orange edge outlining. Use plausible bolted gusset plates at brace joins, small correctly spaced fasteners, ordinary flat plates and straight weld seams, no rows of decorative huge rivets. Background walls are plain dark corrugated sheet metal, quiet ribs and believable overlaps; one modest electrical conduit routed neatly along a beam to the lights. Neutral low-intensity work lighting, a slight warm grey cast; remove exaggerated blue spotlight cones and polished specular strips. Show enough subtle wall and steel detail to read the volume without making the background busy. Centre remains dark and calm for foreground faces and dialogue. The floor/platform is dark practical worn steel with restrained texture, no glossy reflections, no lavish ornate grille. Keep an unobtrusive thin black front platform edge. Do not add more railings across the middle because people will sit there. No people, no furniture, no text, no sign, no LED display, no plants, no crates, no extra hanging cables or random clutter. Nothing on this image should say rustic cabin, pirate set, luxury studio, sci-fi or industrial fantasy.
Match the original game's detailed pixel grain using controlled clustered colours and restrained dithering. Realism comes from geometry, material and lighting, not high-frequency photo noise. Crisp scene features, no soft painted blur. This is still a bitmap game backdrop consistent with detailed character sprites. Output full wide environment, approximately 3072x1024, exactly preserve the 3:1 aspect ratio and beam locations, no cropping or dramatic new camera.
sourcePrompts.sign:

Repaint the entire WOOD SURFACE MATTE BLACK / soft charcoal, opaque black paint with a faint woodgrain visible in grazing light; no brown exposed edge, no distressed chips. Lettering remains warm OFF-WHITE spray paint, clean clear edges with tiny realistic overspray, no shadows, no dimensional typography. Black paint absorbs most light, soft natural highlight enough to reveal wood material and screw heads. Make a beautiful convincing simple practical handmade prop: neat, sturdy, no decorative edging, no holes between boards, no ropes/hooks/chains.
Remove the workshop wall, LED screen and ALL background around sign. Genuine transparent background, isolated sign sprite, no vignette or backdrop. Front-on same sign proportions as reference, complete object uncropped, 8 percent margin. Translate photographic materials into grounded detailed game pixel-art colour clusters matching an industrial hangar adventure-game backdrop, not exaggerated huge blocky pixels, not photo-noise. Lettering has exact consistent shape and scale. Landscape 1536x1024 canvas, sign itself is a wide short rectangle, NOT stretched to fill height. Only one sign, no other text or objects.

neonPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the APPROVED full game composition. Image 2 is a CLOSEUP of the existing title sign for material reference only. Produce ONE full game-screen mockup at the same 16:9 ratio and layout as image 1. Change ONLY the upper-right EVOLUTION WARS sign and the very small physically plausible light spill on the wall immediately behind it. All other pixels/content should be visually unchanged: preserve the same dark realistic hangar, same beams and lamps, same commentator and opponent faces/poses/size, ticker with its thin black frame and orange LED text, all panels and UI, arena, points, cards and graphs. Do not redesign the set or add lights elsewhere. No cinematic bloom across the whole screen.
The approved sign is tightly joined wood painted MATTE BLACK, small corner screws, standard upright lettering EVOLUTION / WARS, with the same letter height across both rows and WARS centred shorter beneath. Retain its rectangular panel size, same place in the top-right column, same little woodgrain, hairline joints, practical handmade construction. It must still look like physical equipment in a tech millionaire's improvised island hangar. Add the specific lighting/colour treatment below, matching the screenshot's grounded detailed game bitmap style. Physical tubes are small narrow actual glass cylinders, with discrete support clips and sensible black wiring; lights must have a thin bright core and subtle nearby coloured reflections on black wood, not flat vector outlines, not a bright UI frame. No fantasy glow, no cyberpunk nightclub, no decorative rivets or grunge, no changing letter shapes into a movie logo, no blue/pink wash over faces. Realistically modest brightness, less visually dominant than the people. Keep title readable at the actual small screen size. Output complete screenshot, no extra captions, no split panels, no zoom, no perspective or proportion changes. Treatment B: KEEP EVOLUTION in the original OFF-WHITE spray-painted stencil alphabet at its original size and position. Replace ONLY the WARS word on the second row with physical slender RED-ORANGE neon GLASS TUBES bent into plain upright monoline block capitals "WARS", same nominal cap height and overall word width as the painted word was, not enlarged. The old lower paint letters are absent. This is a simple custom neon addition screwed onto the same existing black wooden board. Tube letters have visible sensible rounded bends, tiny clips, dark return sections and small black leads discreetly routed behind the wood. Bright narrow warm coral/red-orange core, restrained red local reflection on the wood directly behind letters. No filled solid red lettering, no doubled tube outlines around fat stencil letters, no cursive writing. EVOLUTION remains the main word. No neon border, no other decorative colour. Believable small workshop-installed neon add-on with readable physical lettering, not a nightclub sign.
